measured_findings: Same-job resume14 ran the integrated reporter and independent reviewer. Seven review findings were returned, then reporter revision failed with report_evidence_ref_not_allowed because evidence_ref included Markdown labels and multiple links. The published local HTML is the unaccepted controller fallback, not the final report.
The original terminal gap was caused by a valid persisted investigation result whose step_attempt status was handoff_accepted; the terminal reader had accepted only complete.

Fresh independent review r2 found that an identity-matching successful attempt with an invalid output could fall through to a valid failure handoff and still satisfy terminal output. The correction now preserves a cause-bearing gap and skips that handoff path.

Focused regression coverage includes success output readback, tampered handoff_accepted output plus valid failure handoff, strict failed-stage handoffs, crash/publication reconciliation, and the report author path prompt.
review_scope: Verify terminal reconciliation reads and hash-verifies persisted output for complete and handoff_accepted, exact job/source_run identity, and emits completed_attempt_output only after successful readback.
Verify a matching successful attempt with a missing/unreadable/hash-invalid output remains incomplete with a cause-bearing gap and cannot be replaced by any failure handoff.
Verify non-success failed/unknown attempts still require strict same-invocation identity-bound content-bearing failure handoffs.
Verify normal and reviewer-driven author turns share the exact raw allowed path prompt and do not loosen report evidence-validation wiring in the changed production source.
scope_limitations: The actual report evidence allowlist validator and HTML renderer are in reporting.py, outside this review target; do not claim their internals were reviewed. Prior review finding and this limit are preserved in FC10/terminal-handoff-and-report-evidence-path-review-r2.json.
